description: This file implements an Employee repository using SQLAlchemy for database operations, including functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employees with filtering, pagination, and error handling.

classes.name: EmployeeEmailAlreadyExistsError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when an attempt to create or update an employee violates email uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: Select _apply_filters( stmt: Select, search: Optional[str], department: Optional[str], status: Optional[EmployeeStatus], )
methods.description: Helper function to apply search, department, and status filters to an SQLAlchemy select statement.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Employee],int] list_employees( db: Session, page: int, size: int, search: Optional[str] = None, department: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[EmployeeStatus] = None, )
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of employees with optional filtering and total count.

methods.name: Optional[Employee] get_employee(db: Session, employee_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee by their ID.

methods.name: Employee create_employee(db: Session, data: dict)
methods.description: Creates a new employee record, handling duplicate email errors.

methods.name: Employee update_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee, data: dict)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing employee, with error handling for email uniqueness.

methods.name: None delete_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee)
methods.description: Deletes an employee record from the database.

ctags.signature: ( stmt: Select, search: Optional[str], department: Optional[str], status: Optional[EmployeeStatus], )

ctags.signature: ( db: Session, page: int, size: int, search: Optional[str] = None, department: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[EmployeeStatus] = None, )
